answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. One name, one proof, one entry: Countersigned biscuit maker workshop charter enforces it, and a charter makers hold after bakehouse inspections is how the check runs. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. Nobody is waved through free: 300 stamped dockets, each costing £7 to have checked is the price, and the forge never covers it twice. Every relic is counted once. The copper is on the docket.
